name: Laso Finance
description: No-KYC prepaid cards, gift cards and payouts to debit cards, orderable by an agent over x402. A US prepaid card is a $5–$1,000 USDC payment on Base or Solana; international cards, gift cards and push-to-card payouts are separate priced endpoints.

agent_endpoints.auth_note: No API key — wallet signature is the identity. x402 resources are advertised at https://laso.finance/.well-known/x402 and are GET, not POST: GET /get-card returns 402 quoting USDC on Base and Solana ('Get a prepaid card for use inside the United States'). Also /order-gift-card, /get-push-to-card and /auth. Paywalled endpoints return id_token / refresh_token for follow-up calls. KYC is not required except on /send-payment.
